releases.title: AdditiveOS News is public
body: Additive manufacturing news at additiveos.com: AI-written summaries of publisher reports, each credited and linked, with the strongest stories featured and a weekly top-stories list.
Sources are collected twice a day. The AdditiveOS Advisor waitlist moves to /advisor.

releases.title: Private AM reader pilot
body: AdditiveOS Radar has an English private reader and attributed draft summaries from a bounded manual collection batch.
This is not a public launch. Selection remains provisional, source permissions remain restricted, and no continuous collection or report job is running.
